clips.title: The story
paras: Calvin Montague sends a Nondescript Letter east from Deathknell to Innkeeper Renee in Brill. He gives it to newly awakened Forsaken as an excuse to leave the valley and reach the Gallows' End Tavern.

Calvin Montague asks newly arisen Forsaken near Deathknell to carry an unmarked envelope east to Brill. He claims he is tired from fighting zombies and spiders, and says the letter is for an innkeeper named Renee. His promise of rich compensation sounds hollow, and the errand takes travelers out of the valley toward the Gallows' End Tavern.
